summary: Closed Phase 13 (Build the Deployed-Tree Fixture Once and Lend It Read-Only) [COMPLETED WITH EXCLUSIONS]. Built a shared deployed-tree fixture in run-all.sh, built once before any suite runs and lent read-only (chmod -R a-w) to declared consumers, plus common_test_fixture_overlay in lib/common.sh (cp -a --reflink=auto, never hardlinks) for a consumer that must mutate it. Investigated the realistic consumer set directly against each of the 38 core integration-classified suites' own content, rather than trusting suite-classification.data's documented conservative textual-reference reason field, and found exactly one genuine consumer (test-deploy-orphans.sh, now migrated, 8/8 assertions identical standalone and under the shared fixture). Excluded three suites with evidence (test-deploy-propagation.sh, test-gate-cache-equivalence.sh, test-deploy-verify-wiring.sh -- each drives multiple/flag-varied real deploy-headless.sh/verify-deploy.sh invocations whose own variance is what they verify); the remaining rows are textual-reference false positives or already migrated by task 416 onto an unrelated rsync-based fixture. Discovered and fixed a two-sibling-artifact overlay gap mid-migration (.claude-extensions.json and .syncprotect, project-root siblings of .claude/, both needed by find_orphans -- an incomplete overlay produced 743 false orphan findings before the fix). Added test-run-all-shared-fixture.sh (8 assertions: build-once-when-selected, never-built-when-unused, write-blocked) and 6 new assertions in test-common-lib.sh. Documented the contract in shell-script-testing.md. Net deltas recorded but net-POSITIVE (NET-PROD +109, NET-TEST +267, NET-MD +51), justified in the plan's closing note as the cheapest route to a later negative net (reusable future-growth-prevention infrastructure) rather than reverted. Full redeploy + full verify-deploy.sh battery run twice, 39 checks / 0 failures both times. A mid-phase informal --jobs auto run surfaced 6 transient failures traced to a concurrent sibling process live-mutating specs/state.json/TODO.md during the run (host-state contention, logged, unrelated to this phase, not reproduced on either full verification run). 7 of 20 plan phases remain, starting with Phase 14 (selection surface for run-all.sh).
